contexts.text: Breathing then receded more towards the abdomen. SE 3324.
When such spirits are present they induce a sensible anxiety in the part of the abdomen immediately below the diaphragm. AC 5724. See also AC 5378:2.
The inhabitants of the moon speak from air collected in the abdomen. See also AC 9234. SE 3241-3245.
Chastising spirits induce a pain in the region of the abdomen of the inhabitants of that earth who think and do evilly.
(The contraction of the abdomen that is caused by a sad state of mind.)
When the popes sit in the consistory they feel something creeping and turning about in the abdomen when anyone else says what is approved of.
The anxiety of very deceitful spirits caused a pain in the region of the abdomen.
